description: Single-cell Li-Ion linear charger, 4.2 V, up to 1 A set by one resistor, charging and done status outputs, battery NTC input

datasheet.revision: Shenzhen TPOWER TP4056 V1.3 (7 pages, with the SOP8-PP outline)

package.name: SOP-8-PP (SOIC-8 with exposed pad)
package.page: p. 7, SOP8-PP outline (D1 3.202-3.402 along the rows, E2 2.313-2.513 across)

pins.name: TEMP
pins.description: battery NTC input; to GND when not used

pins.name: PROG
pins.description: charge current set resistor to GND

pins.name: BAT
pins.description: to the battery's positive terminal, 4.2 V

pins.name: nSTDBY
pins.description: charge done: low when complete (overlined STDBY)

parameters.conditions: Input supply current in charge mode, RPROG = 1.2 kohm, TA = 25 degC, VCC = 5 V; standby (charge terminated) and shutdown are 55 uA typ / 100 uA max; this is the chip's own draw, the charge current is separate

source.revision: NanJing Top Power ASIC TP4056 datasheet (3 pages, no revision printed)
source.location: p. 2, Electrical Characteristics, ICC (input supply current) row, charge mode

parameters.conditions: Maximum junction temperature; the thermal-regulation limit TLIM is 145 degC typ

source.revision: NanJing Top Power ASIC TP4056 datasheet (3 pages, no revision printed)
source.location: p. 1, Absolute Maximum Ratings, Maximum Junction Temperature

parts.rating: in series with C1 (damps the input when a cable is plugged in)
1% (about 1 A; 2.4 kohm about 500 mA, 10 kohm about 130 mA)

options.name: statusLeds
options.description: The red (charging) and green (charged) LEDs through one 1 kohm resistor from VCC.

options.name: noNtc
options.description: TEMP to GND: the battery has no NTC.

notes: CE to VCC (always enabled). TEMP to GND when the battery has no NTC; with one, R1 from VCC and R2 to GND set the window with the NTC (charging stops outside 45-80 % of VCC).
Charge current: IBAT = 1100 V / RPROG by the V1.3 document; the original 3-page document's table: 1.2 kohm 1000 mA, 2.4 kohm 500 mA, 10 kohm 130 mA (the two differ by about 10 %).
Both LEDs share one 1 kohm resistor from VCC: red (nCHRG) lit while charging, green (nSTDBY) lit when done.
The exposed pad carries the heat (up to about 1 W at 1 A from 5 V): solder it to a GND copper area with vias.
Status outputs are open drain: pull up (an LED from VCC, or a resistor to the logic supply); unused ones to GND.
Floating PROG or CE low stops charging.
